description:
ModelVault designs and builds tailored AI solutions for business: autonomous AI agents, RAG systems and knowledge bases, predictive models (forecasting, churn, maintenance), anomaly detection, automation pipelines, document processing and integrations.

With this app, right in chat, you can: find which services fit your case, match a business problem to the most suitable solution, see published projects and evidence, understand the process, pricing and deployment options, open the live demos on the website, and prepare a quote request (a ready-to-send email draft that you review and send). Infrastructure in Italy, pay-as-you-go.

defaultPrompt: Che servizi AI offre ModelVault per un'azienda come la mia?
Ho un processo manuale da automatizzare: quale soluzione ModelVault fa per il mio caso?
Mostrami un progetto ModelVault simile al mio caso e prepara una richiesta di preventivo
